concept.name: Delta
concept.definition: For a small stock move, delta approximates the option value change per unit of stock movement.
concept.matters: It sets the first-order stock hedge and contributes to portfolio risk.
concept.changes: Spot, strike, time, volatility, rate, dividends and option type.
concept.limitation: Delta changes as inputs change; delta-neutral does not mean risk-free.

maths.equation: Δ = ∂V/∂S; position Δ = q × m × Δ

variables.\u0394: option price sensitivity per underlying unit
variables.V: option model value in GBP per unit
variables.\u2202: local partial derivative holding other inputs fixed

concept.name: Z-score

concept.matters: It expresses a deviation relative to its own recent scale.
concept.changes: Current residual, earlier residual mean and earlier residual standard deviation.
concept.limitation: A z-score is not a probability or a trade recommendation; tiny variance can make it unstable.
